headline: Beat-and-raise quarter, but cost growth trims margins
summary_short: Royal Caribbean's Q2 2026 revenue rose 6% y/y to $4.83B on 5% capacity growth and a record 110% load factor, but net income fell 7% y/y to $1.13B ($4.20 diluted EPS) as cost growth outpaced Net Yield gains. The company raised full-year 2026 Adjusted EPS guidance to $17.73-$17.87.
summary_long: Revenue grew 6% y/y to $4.83B on 5% capacity growth, 6% more guests carried, and a record 110% load factor. Net Yields rose 1.9% as-reported, but Gross Margin Yields fell 5.6% and Net Cruise Costs ex-fuel rose 4.4%, so net income fell 7% y/y to $1.13B and diluted EPS fell to $4.20 even as both rose sharply sequentially. Management attributed the beat to stronger close-in demand, lower costs, and favorable joint-venture performance. The company raised full-year 2026 Adjusted EPS guidance to $17.73-$17.87 and issued Q3 2026 Adjusted EPS guidance of $6.26-$6.36, while flagging a modest booking impact on select itineraries from prolonged geopolitical activity. Liquidity stood at $6.9B; cash rose to $875M.
